title: Art of storytelling: How authentic narratives build trust, attract capital, and create loyal communities
description: How can authentic storytelling serve as a powerful tool to build trust, attract capital, and nurture loyal communities? Kunal Kapoor, actor and co-founder of Ketto, shares insights from his entrepreneurial journey on translating purpose and passion into narratives that inspire action and drive impact.

title: The VC’s compass: Resilience & reinvention in India’s AI decade
description: From India’s SaaS revolution to the coming AI wave, investors are rethinking how they evaluate capital efficiency. Drawing from decades of backing India’s boldest entrepreneurs, Vani Kola of Kalaari Capital shares where the next decade of innovation is headed, and how investors and founders can align purpose, patience, and performance in the AI-first era.

title: Powering India’s Web3 future with Binance: Innovation, skills, trust in digital finance
description: As India advances towards Viksit Bharat, Web3 stands at the intersection of innovation, financial inclusion, and youth empowerment. Kushal Manupati of Binance explores how global blockchain innovation, financial literacy, and responsible adoption can shape a secure and future-ready digital economy.

speaker.name: Kushal Manupati
speaker.designation: Growth and Operations Lead, South Asia, Binance

title: Crafting the tech adoption journey for MSMEs: The Tally playbook
description: Discover the untold stories and secrets behind Tally's success in building high trust and solving for complexity to make Indian companies future-ready and digital-first.

title: Sky’s the limit: Building a global drone hub from India
description: India’s drone economy is taking flight. From agriculture and logistics to infrastructure, surveillance, and emergency response, the technology is reshaping industries and creating new opportunities for innovation and employment. Kinjarapu Rammohan Naidu, Hon’ble Minister of Civil Aviation, Government of India, joins Shradha Sharma, Founder & CEO, YourStory, to discuss India’s vision of becoming a global drone hub. The session will explore the government’s evolving policy framework, the push for domestic manufacturing and R&D, and how India can build a thriving, export-ready drone ecosystem that competes on the world stage.

speaker.name: Hon'ble Minister Shri Kinjarapu Rammohan Naidu
speaker.designation: Union Minister of Civil Aviation, Govt of India

title: Building Bharat: How AI is changing the fintech game
description: AI is transforming how India moves money, making payments smarter, faster, and more inclusive. Gautam Aggarwal, Mastercard's South Asia Head, shares how the global payments leader is building intelligence and trust into every transaction, shaping a digital economy where innovation fuels inclusion and Bharat’s financial backbone grows stronger.

title: Future of Work and Leading in the Age of AI
description: AI is not just transforming how we work—it’s redefining what it means to lead. In this thought-provoking keynote, Puneet Chandok unpacks how the rise of AI is reshaping organizations, decision-making and the very fabric of work. He will share powerful insights on what the future of work could look like, and how founders & leaders can navigate this new era—where human creativity and machine intelligence come together to unlock the next wave of innovation.

title: AI, Access, Ambition: How India builds the future of global apps
description: India’s billion-user digital ecosystem is redefining the global app economy. With GenAI enabling hyper-personalised, multilingual, and voice-first experiences, developers are building for Bharat and scaling for the world. Learn from leaders helming India-first app ecosystems and solutions about how AI, India Stack, and design-for-diversity innovation are powering the next generation of globally competitive digital products.

title: AI x blockchain: Empowering India’s next builders
description: The convergence of AI and blockchain is leading to decentralised, intelligent systems for the world. Devika Mittal shares how India’s developer ecosystem is driving global innovation, and how Ava Labs is enabling this growth through open infrastructure, partnerships, and talent empowerment.

title: Investing in India’s global tech moment, powered by intelligence
description: India’s next decade of innovation will be built through collaboration—between founders, investors, and nations. As the lines between data, AI, and finance blur, global partners are finding new ways to share opportunity and scale innovation responsibly. Discover how capital, technology, and partnerships can create seamless growth corridors.

speaker.name: Malini Dutt
speaker.designation: Trade and Investment Commissioner, India, NSW

title: The future of software development in the age of AI
description: Address how generative AI, hyper-automation, and AI-driven Dev & Ops are changing the way software is built, reducing time-to-market and improving reliability. Discuss the rise of low-code/no-code platforms empowered by AI, enabling a new generation of citizen developers and changing the skill set required for software professionals.

speaker.name: Hemant Kamatgi
speaker.designation: Vice President of Customer Experience Platforms, Ford Motor Company

title: Intelligence at scale: Building growth for a connected India
description: As India’s digital economy scales, intelligence and infrastructure are redefining how growth is built. Arzan Singpurwalla and Praveen Sridhar explore how Meta and AWS are enabling builders and ISVs to power connected, conversational, and data-driven experiences that drive business transformation.

speaker.name: Arzan Singpurwalla
speaker.designation: Lead Channel Partnerships, Business Messaging - India, Meta

title: Tokyo calling: A new launchpad for India’s startups
description: As Indian startups expand globally, Japan is emerging as a powerful destination offering deep-tech collaboration, patient capital, and a thriving innovation ecosystem centred in Tokyo. Explores how founders can tap into opportunities in the country, leverage Tokyo Metropolitan Government’s (TMG) support initiatives, and build meaningful Indo-Japan partnerships for sustainable global growth.

speaker.name: Kiyoko Hashiba
speaker.designation: Director for Global Promotion, Tokyo Metropolitan Government

speaker.name: Naoto Nakadate
speaker.designation: Senior Director, Japan-India Startup Hub, JETRO

speaker.name: Yoko Fukata
speaker.designation: Director/Head of Sony Ventures India, Sony Ventures Corporation

title: The speed layer: Real-time AI powering India’s fintech future
description: India’s fintech ecosystem is on the brink of an AI-led leap, from predictive payments to real-time risk intelligence. In this high-level dialogue, Paytm and Groq leaders will discuss how ultra-fast inference and purpose-built infrastructure can power new business models, enhance trust and security, and set the foundation for a future where finance operates at the speed of intelligence.

title: Building India's AI-powered digital infra: From payments to data at scale
description: As India accelerates toward a $5-trillion digital economy, AI is redefining its national infrastructure, from payments and data centres to cloud and compute. Explore how India’s AI-powered digital backbone is evolving through open, interoperable, and sovereign-first frameworks. Leaders and experts will discuss how policy, innovation, and infrastructure investments can together drive inclusive, sustainable, and globally competitive AI growth.

speaker.name: Venkat Ragothaman
speaker.designation: Senior Director Of Engineering, Security & AI, NetApp

title: Inside Zepto & the algorithm powering instant fulfilment
description: Building India first tech, for India by Indians - How Zepto has built its rapid action in-store digital ecosystem, from order-picking to IoT-enabled shelving to barcode scanning, to automated restocking alerts, and fulfillment tracking. And what it does it take to build a profitable dark store in the age of AI and auto.
